sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A STRONG MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH INVOF THE FOUR CORNERS WILL PROGRESS EWD OVER THE SRN PLAINS BY EARLY TONIGHT...AND APPROACH THE MS VALLEY BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. MEANWHILE...A SURFACE BAROCLINIC ZONE IS LOCATED FROM THE MIDDLE TX COASTAL PLAIN ENEWD INTO SRN LA...AND THEN ESEWD JUST OFF THE NE GULF COAST. THIS BOUNDARY WILL MOVE SLOWLY INLAND AS A WARM FRONT TODAY AND TONIGHT ACROSS MS/AL/N FL/SW GA...IN RESPONSE TO CYCLOGENESIS BY TONIGHT ACROSS NRN MS/NW AL/WRN TN IN ADVANCE OF THE MIDLEVEL TROUGH. BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE MID-UPPER 60S...BENEATH THE ERN EXTENT OF AN ELEVATED MIXED LAYER PLUME...WILL SUPPORT MODERATE INSTABILITY IN THE WARM SECTOR AND AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR SEVERE STORMS THROUGH THE PERIOD.

sections.title: N TX EWD TO NRN LA AND CENTRAL MS TODAY
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF ELEVATED STORMS IN N TX IS ASSOCIATED WITH LOW-LEVEL WAA ABOVE THE SHALLOW COOL AIR MASS THAT CONTINUES TO SAG SEWD ACROSS S CENTRAL TX AND THE MIDDLE-UPPER TX COASTAL PLAIN. 700-500 MB LAPSE RATES OF 7.5-8.5 C/KM AND RICH MOISTURE ABOVE THE SHALLOW COOL AIR ARE CONTRIBUTING TO MUCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG ROOTED NEAR 850 MB. THIS CONVECTION AND THE ASSOCIATED ZONE OF ASCENT WILL SPREAD EWD THROUGH THE DAY WITH A CONTINUING RISK FOR LARGE HAIL TO THE N OF THE SURFACE FRONT. THE HAIL RISK WILL BE ENHANCED BY EMBEDDED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES AS A RESULT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AOA 50 KT IN THE MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT...ESPECIALLY WHERE CONVECTION IS ROOTED CLOSER TO THE GROUND IMMEDIATELY N OF THE SURFACE FRONT...ACROSS NRN LA INTO W CENTRAL MS THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: SRN MS/SRN AL/SRN GA/N FL THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS SPREADING NWD/NEWD THIS MORNING IN A WEAK WAA REGIME ACROSS THE N CENTRAL/NE GULF COAST. THE INITIAL CONVECTION THIS MORNING WILL BE ELEVATED TO THE N OF THE WARM FRONT...BUT THERE WILL BE INCREASING POTENTIAL FOR SURFACE-BASED STORMS NEAR THE COAST BY MID-LATE MORNING...SPREADING GRADUALLY INLAND DURING THE AFTERNOON. LOW-LEVEL FLOW WILL NOT BE STRONG TODAY...BUT DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING GUSTS. A TORNADO OR TWO WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH SURFACE-BASED STORMS ALONG THE WARM FRONT TODAY...GIVEN THE MOIST LOW-LEVEL ENVIRONMENT AND SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL SHEAR. OVERNIGHT...LOW-LEVEL FLOW/SHEAR IS FORECAST TO INCREASE AS THE PRIMARY SYNOPTIC WAVE APPROACHES FROM THE W...AND CYCLOGENESIS PROCEEDS ACROSS THE MS VALLEY. THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT WILL PERSIST THROUGH TONIGHT ALONG THE WARM FRONT AND MUCH OF THE SAME CORRIDOR AS THE CONVECTION TODAY...WHICH COULD LIMIT INLAND PENETRATION OF THE WARM SECTOR. THE THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS WILL ALSO CONTINUE THROUGH TONIGHT...AS WELL AS THE RISK FOR A FEW TORNADOES AS LOW-LEVEL SHEAR INCREASES. STORM COVERAGE IS IN QUESTION ALONG THE CO

sections.title: FL/GA
sections.text: A LARGE CLUSTER OF INTENSE THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING OVER SOUTHERN GA AND NORTH FL. THE STRONGEST OF THESE STORMS HAVE PRODUCED LARGE HAIL. WEAK LOW LEVEL WARM ADVECTION AND LIFT WILL LIKELY MAINTAIN THIS ACTIVITY FOR A FEW MORE HOURS AS IT SPREADS EASTWARD TOWARD THE COAST. ANOTHER BAND OF CONVECTION APPEARS TO BE INTENSIFYING OFF THE COAST OF THE FL PANHANDLE...ALONG A RETREATING WARM FRONT. THESE STORMS MAY SPREAD INLAND LATER THIS AFTERNOON...CONTINUING THE RISK OF LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS. SUFFICIENT LOW/MID LEVEL VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE PRESENT FOR A RISK OF SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF ALL FACETS OF SEVERE WEATHER. REFERENCE MCD NUMBER 299 FOR FURTHER DETAILS.

sections.title: LA/MS/AL
sections.text: A WARM FRONT CURRENTLY EXTENDS FROM SOUTHEAST TX...EASTWARD ACROSS SOUTHERN LA INTO SOUTHERN MS. THIS BOUNDARY IS MAKING VERY LITTLE PROGRESS NORTHWARD. NEVERTHELESS...BROKEN CLOUDS TO THE NORTH OF THE BOUNDARY MAY RESULT IN DEEPER MIXING AND SOME NORTHWARD PROGRESSION LATER TODAY. A WEAKENING CAP AND MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL POSE A RISK OF SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT BY MID-LATE AFTERNOON. DESPITE RATHER WEAK FORCING MECHANISMS...SEVERAL MODEL SOLUTIONS INDICATE A THREAT OF ENHANCED COVERAGE OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS. THEREFORE HAVE MAINTAINED THE 30 PERCENT HAIL RISK ACROSS THIS REGION.

sections.title: TX/LA/MS LATER TONIGHT
sections.text: ANOTHER ROUND OF STRONG STORMS IS EXPECTED LATER TONIGHT AS THE MAIN UPPER TROUGH MOVES INTO THE SOUTHERN PLAINS AND THE COLD FRONT BEGINS TO SURGE EASTWARD. THESE STORMS WILL PROGRESS FROM EAST TX INTO MS WITH A RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. ..HART/COHEN.. 03/23/2013

sections.title: SRN GA/NRN FL WWD TO SRN AL/SERN MS THROUGH THE EVENING
sections.text: EARLY AFTERNOON SURFACE ANALYSIS INDICATED LITTLE NWD MOVEMENT OF THE E-W ORIENTED WARM FRONT EXTENDING FROM SRN LA TO THE NRN FL PENINSULA. THE EXCEPTION HAS BEEN THE PORTION OF THIS BOUNDARY OFFSHORE MS/AL AND THE WRN FL PANHANDLE...WHERE TRENDS SUGGEST THE FRONT HAS MOVED CLOSER TO THE COAST AND LIKELY EXTENDED ACROSS GULF AND FRANKLIN COUNTIES FL. THE FORECAST ACROSS THESE AREAS OF THE CENTRAL GULF COAST EWD TO NRN FL/SRN GA REMAINS ON TRACK...WITH THE INITIAL CLUSTER OF STORMS MOVING OFF THE NERN FL COAST...WHILE STORMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP UPSTREAM AND TRACK EWD IN VICINITY AND N OF THE WARM FRONT. A SLIGHT RISK FOR SEVERE STORMS WILL BE MAINTAINED WITH THIS OUTLOOK ISSUANCE...WITH ADDITIONAL DETAILS AVAILABLE IN VALID AND SUBSEQUENT MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS RELEVANT TO WW/S 57 AND 58. A COUPLE STORMS...CURRENTLY LOCATED OFFSHORE THE NERN GULF COAST...COULD PRODUCE VERY LARGE HAIL BOTH OVER THE WATER AND AS THEY REACH THE FL COAST. STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...MODERATE INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-50 KT SUPPORT SUPERCELLS AND THIS HAIL POTENTIAL...IN ADDITION TO DAMAGING WINDS AND A TORNADO. THE LATTER THREAT WOULD BE GREATEST INVOF THE WARM FRONT WHERE LOW LEVEL SH

sections.title: E TX/LA/MS
sections.text: AN INCREASE IN TSTM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS TO BE UNDERWAY ACROSS PARTS OF E TX /REFERENCE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 304/ IN RESPONSE TO LARGE SCALE ASCENT SPREADING DOWNSTREAM AHEAD OF THE CO/NM SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND AN APPARENT LEAD IMPULSE/JET STREAK ADVANCING EWD ACROSS W TX. 12Z 4 KM WRF-NMM/NSSL SUGGEST THESE STORMS MAY EVOLVE INTO A FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS ACROSS NRN LA THROUGH CENTRAL AND PARTS OF SRN MS TO CENTRAL AL THIS EVENING INTO THE OVERNIGHT. GIVEN THE LACK OF TSTM DEVELOPMENT THUS FAR OVER MUCH OF LA AND CENTRAL/SRN MS...THIS AIR MASS WILL CONTINUE TO MOISTEN/DESTABILIZE INTO THE EVENING WITH A WARM FRONT ADVANCING NWD. THIS OBSERVATIONAL DATA SUPPORTS THE HIGHER RESOLUTION MODELS...AND THUS HAVE ADDED A 30 PERCENT SEVERE WIND PROBABILITY FROM NRN LA TO WEST CENTRAL AL. THE WRF-NMM/NSSL ALSO SUGGEST THE ACTIVITY DEVELOPING AND TRACKING EWD FROM NRN LA TO CENTRAL AL COULD BE A QLCS...AND THUS HAVE EXTENDED THE 5 PERCENT TORNADO PROBABILITIES NWWD. ..PETERS.. 03/23/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT SAT MAR 23 2013/ A LARGE UPPER TROUGH IS PRESENT TODAY OVER THE WESTERN STATES...WITH A SERIES OF SHORTWAVE TROUGHS ROTATING ACROSS THE SOUTHERN PLAINS AND GULF COAST REG

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY...DEEP SOUTH
sections.text: EXTENSIVE TSTM COVERAGE WILL LIKELY PERSIST INTO THE OVERNIGHT...PRIMARILY N OF A STATIONARY FRONT ALONG THE GULF COAST. GREATEST NEAR-TERM RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS THIS EVENING SHOULD LIE ACROSS CNTRL MS/AL WITH ELEVATED BOWING/SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY CONGEAL WITH THE PERSISTENT TSTM BANDS CURRENTLY FROM SRN MS TO THE ERN FL PANHANDLE. OVERALL SEVERE THREAT MAY BE MARGINALIZE FOR A BRIEF PERIOD AS THIS OCCURS GIVEN THE CLUSTER MODE AND OVERTURNING/WEAKER DOWNSTREAM LAPSE RATES. OVERNIGHT...MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS ATTENDANT TO THE VIGOROUS SHORT WAVE IMPULSE EJECTING FROM THE SRN HIGH PLAINS TO THE OZARK PLATEAU WILL OVERSPREAD THE REGION AND INDUCE DEEPENING OF A SURFACE CYCLONE MOVING NEWD FROM COASTAL LA. COASTAL STATIONARY FRONT SHOULD PENETRATE INLAND SOMEWHAT AS THE LLJ STRENGTHENS. OPERATIONAL GUIDANCE STILL LARGELY APPEARS TO BE TOO AGGRESSIVE WITH THE NWD ADVANCEMENT OF THE FRONT GIVEN COMPARISON TO CURRENT SURFACE OBS AND THE EXTENSIVE CONVECTION N OF THE BOUNDARY. NEVERTHELESS...BOTH OPERATIONAL AND CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODELS ARE HIGHLY CONSISTENT THAT SW/NE-ORIENTED CONVECTIVE BANDS WILL FORM BY 09-12Z ACROSS THE FL PANHANDL

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED SVR TSTMS DEVELOPING ALONG A NORTHWARD-MOVING WARM WILL POSE A RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE MORNING. CONDITIONS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTMS WERE DEVELOPING IN THE VICINITY OF A WARM FRONT EXTENDING FROM SRN LA TO JUST SOUTH OF THE COAST OF THE WESTERN FL PANHANDLE. A SLOW NORTHWARD MOVEMENT OF THE FRONT IS EXPECTED THROUGH THE MORNING HOURS. LATEST MESOANALYSIS SUGGESTS AN ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTIVE OF CONTINUED TSTM DEVELOPMENT AND INTENSIFICATION WITH 0-6 KM SHEAR IN EXCESS OF 60 KTS AS SAMPLED BY THE KMOB AND KTLH WSR-88DS AND 1000-1500 J/KG OF MUCAPE BASED ON MESOANALYSIS. ALTHOUGH FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH DISTURBANCES IN THE STRENGTHENING MID-TROPOSPHERIC FLOW REMAINS LARGELY TO THE NORTH OF THIS AREA THIS MORNING...MODEST WARM ADVECTION IN THE VICINITY OF THE WARM FRONT SHOULD RESULT IN ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT THROUGH THE MORNING HOURS. SUPERCELL STRUCTURES ARE POSSIBLE WITH A RISK OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS GIVEN STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ON THE 12Z KTLH SOUNDING AND PW VALUES OF 1.4 INCHES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PARTS OF NE TX AND NW LA MAY SEE AN INCREASING CHANCE FOR SVR STORMS THIS MORNING. ISOLATED BUT INTENSE DEEP CONVECTION MOVING 50KT FROM KAUFMAN COUNTY TO VAN ZANDT COUNTY HAS PRODUCED COPIOUS HAIL. THIS STORM MAY PERSIST INTO NE TX WITH ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLY WARRANTING A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A WELL DEVELOPED CLUSTER OF ORGANIZED DEEP CONVECTION HAS RACED EAST FROM SOUTH OF DALLAS AREA THIS MORNING WITH A HISTORY OF MODESTLY SEVERE-SIZED HAIL AROUND 1 INCH IN DIAMETER AND SMALLER HAIL IN COPIOUS AMOUNTS. THIS STORM COMPLEX INITIATED EARLIER ALONG ELEVATED PORTION OF DEEP-LAYER FRONTAL ZONE WHERE A PLUME OF MUCAPE WAS AOA 1000 J/KG. WHILE WELL REMOVED FROM SURFACE QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT TO THE SOUTH NEAR THE GULF COAST...LIFT ACROSS THE REGION MAY SUSTAIN DEEP CONVECTION IN A CORRIDOR WHERE STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 8 C/KM AND POTENT CLOUD-BEARING SHEAR WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT UPDRAFT PERSISTENCE AND THE PRODUCTION OF HAIL. WHILE LARGER SCALE ASCENT ACROSS THE REGION REMAINS SOMEWHAT SUBTLE/WEAK IN THE SHORT-TERM...STRONGER HEIGHT FALLS WILL BEGIN TO INFLUENCE LIFT ACROSS THE DEEP-LAYER FRONT LATER THIS MORNING AND COULD SUPPORT AN INCREASE IN OVERALL STORM COVERAGE...ESPECIALLY FROM EXTREME E TX ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY. A WATCH...OR WATCHES...MAY BE NEEDED AT THIS SCENARIO UNFOLDS LATER THIS MORNING AND INTO THE AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SVR TSTM WATCH WILL BE ISSUED SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ELEVATED CONVECTION WITH A THREAT FOR SVR HAIL WILL OVERSPREAD THE AREA AS A LOW-AMPLITUDE MID-LEVEL IMPULSE CROSSES THE NERN GULF COAST AMIDST STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND STRONG DEEP SHEAR. CLOSER TO THE GULF COAST...STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY BECOME ROOTED IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER AS SFC DESTABILIZATION OCCURS...WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR AN INCREASE IN SVR WINDS THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WHILE EARLIER SEVERE STORM COMPLEX ACROSS NERN TX HAS WEAKENED...THERE REMAINS SOME CHANCE FOR ADDITIONAL INTENSE TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE REGION INTO THIS AFTERNOON. LARGE HAIL WOULD LIKELY BE THE GREATEST THREAT FROM THIS DEVELOPMENT IF IT OCCURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE CLUSTER OF INTENSE/ORGANIZED CONVECTION RESPONSIBLE FOR NUMEROUS SEVERE HAIL REPORTS ACROSS NRN TX EARLIER THIS MORNING HAS WEAKENED CONSIDERABLY OVER THE PAST 2 HOURS. FOCUS NOW SHIFTS TO EXTREME E TX AND LA FOR NEW OR REINVIGORATED CONVECTION INTO THE AFTERNOON. A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT REMAINS SITUATED NEAR THE GULF COAST FROM GLS NEWD ACROSS LCH TO BTR. ELEVATED STORMS OVER NRN TX REMAIN WELL TO THE NORTH OF THIS BOUNDARY WITH RECENT FOCUSED ASCENT BEING AIDED BY A LEADING LOW-AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCE OVER NRN TX. THIS LEADING DISTURBANCE IS AHEAD OF A MUCH LARGER AND STRONGER TROUGH DIGGING SEWD FROM CO THAT WILL DRIVE FRONTAL WAVE DEVELOPMENT...AND AN SUBSEQUENT INCREASE IN MORE WIDESPREAD SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL ACROSS LA LATER TODAY. HOWEVER...IN THE SHORT-TERM...THE LEADING LOW AMPLITUDE IMPULSE MAY STILL ACT TO PROMOTE STRONG UPDRAFT DEVELOPMENT NORTH OF THE SURFACE FRONT WHERE AMBIENT INSTABILITY AND SHEAR REMAIN SUFFICIENT FOR SEVERE HAIL PRODUCTION. NEW STORMS HAVE FORMED AND APPEAR TO BE INCREASING OVER ANDERSON COUNTY TX SUPPORTING THE ABOVE REASONING. THUS...THE ENTIRE REGION WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WATCH.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PORTIONS OF THE FL PANHANDLE AND FAR SWRN GA ARE BEING MONITORED FOR AN INCREASING SVR THREAT. THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS POSSIBLE...OR WW57 MAY BE EXTENDED WWD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC MESOANALYSIS DEPICTS A WARM FRONT LYING APPROXIMATELY ALONG THE GULF COAST FROM MOBILE BAY TO S OF TLH. A WIND-SHIFT AXIS INTERSECTS THE WARM FRONT 20 WNW AAF AND EXTENDS SWWD INTO THE GULF OFFSHORE WATERS. STRENGTHENING STORMS APPEAR TO BE ANCHORED TO THIS AXIS 55-65 SSW PFN...AND ARE TRACKING ENEWD TOWARD THE COAST. THESE STORMS ARE EMBEDDED WITHIN A BROAD AREA OF MODEST WARM ADVECTION...AND MAY BE A MANIFESTATION OF A SUBTLE ENHANCEMENT TO ISENTROPIC ASCENT IN ASSOCIATION WITH A LOW-AMPLITUDE MID-LEVEL IMPULSE. THERE IS SOME QUESTION AS TO THE COVERAGE OF ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT...THOUGH SOME INCREASE WILL BE POSSIBLE BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON WHILE THE WARM FRONT ADVANCES FARTHER INLAND. STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ACCOMPANYING AN EML THAT HAS OVERSPREAD THE GULF COAST -- 700-500-MB LAPSE RATES OF AROUND 8-8.5 C/KM PER TLH/LIX RAOBS -- WILL SUPPORT A THREAT FOR SVR HAIL WITH ANY SUSTAINED SUPERCELL STORMS AS 40-55 KT OF DEEP SHEAR RESIDE ACROSS THE REGION. WHILE LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG...DIRECTIONAL SHEAR IS BOOSTING LOW-LEVEL SRH SUCH THAT SUSTAINED STORMS INTERACTING WITH THE WARM FRONT OR THE SURFACE-BASED WARM SECTOR S OF THE FRONT COULD CONDITIONALLY POSE A RISK FOR SVR WINDS AND PERHAPS TORNADOES. THIS IS REFLECTED BY TLH VWP DATA THAT INDICATE 250-300 M2/S2 OF 0-1KM SRH. SHOULD GREATER CONVECTIVE COVERAGE BECOME MORE LIKELY...A WW MAY BECOME REQUIRED...OR WW57 MAY BE EXTENDED WWD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR SIGNIFICANT HAIL...POTENTIALLY OF BASEBALL SIZE...WILL ACCOMPANY A SUPERCELL THUNDERSTORM THAT WILL TRACK ACROSS PARTS OF COLUMBIA...BAKER...UNION...AND BRADFORD...POTENTIALLY INTO CLAY...COUNTIES DURING THE NEXT HOUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WSR-88D VOLUMETRIC SCANS SUGGEST THAT A SUPERCELL STORM WITH AN INCREASINGLY DISCRETE UPDRAFT IS POSING A THREAT FOR SIGNIFICANTLY SEVERE HAIL. WDSS-2 MESH DATA INDICATE THAT MAXIMUM HAIL SIZES HAVE POTENTIALLY INCREASED TO OVER 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER RECENTLY. WITH A CONTINUED INFLUX OF HIGH THETA-E ATOP A STABLE NEAR-SFC LAYER AMIDST VERY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...SIGNIFICANT HAIL -- POTENTIALLY OF BASEBALL SIZE -- MAY ACCOMPANY THIS STORM AS IT TRACKS EWD/ESEWD ACROSS PARTS OF NERN FL DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. A LOCAL SPATIAL EXTENSION OF THE WW HAS BEEN COORDINATED WITH THE JACKSONVILLE WEATHER FORECAST OFFICE TO ADDRESS THESE CONCERNS. ..COHEN.. 03/23/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS SHOULD INCREASE FROM THE MS/AL GULF COAST AREAS INLAND ACROSS SRN PORTIONS OF THESE STATES OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS INDICATED IN EARLIER FORECASTS. THE CHANCE FOR LARGE HAIL AND HIGH WINDS WILL LIKEWISE INCREASE WITH STORM COVERAGE AND THUS A WATCH IS LIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A STEADY INCREASE IN CONVECTION HAS BEEN NOTED OVER THE LAST HOUR OR SO ALONG AND SOUTH OF AN E-W ORIENTED WARM FRONT SITUATED INLAND FROM THE NCNTRL GULF COAST FROM THE DELTA REGION OF MS INTO SWRN AL NORTH AND AROUND MOBILE BAY. THIS DEVELOPMENT NEAR THE WARM FRONT WAS LIKELY BEING AIDED BY 1) THE APPROACH OF A LOW-AMPLITUDE SHORT WAVE TROUGH MOVING FROM TX TOWARD LA...AND 2) THE DIURNAL INCREASE IN DESTABILIZATION AND WEAKENING INHIBITION NEAR THE SURFACE FRONT WHERE SBCAPE VALUES HAVE NOW CLIMBED TO AROUND 1000 J/KG. SHORT-TERM STORM SCALE GUIDANCE INDICATES THAT CONVECTION SHOULD CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN BOTH COVERAGE AND VIGOR THROUGH THE REST OF THE AFTERNOON. BOTH DIRECTIONAL AND VERTICAL SPEED SHEAR ACROSS THE REGION WILL REMAIN STRONG AND SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED/ROTATING UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL...AND ...WITH TIME...ORGANIZING INTO BOWING/LEWP STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS. LOW LEVEL WINDS OVER LAND AREAS ARE CURRENTLY WEAK TO MODEST IN STRENGTH AND MAY LIMIT TORNADO POTENTIAL WITH DISCRETE STORMS WHERE EFFECTIVE SRH VALUES ARE PRESENTLY AOB 100 M2/S2. NONETHELESS...SOME INCREASE IN AT LEAST ISOLATED TORNADO POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED GIVEN A FAVORABLE REGIME FOR SUPERCELL STORMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG TO ISOLATED SVR STORMS COULD DEVELOP AFTER 1900Z. GIVEN THE ANTICIPATED ISOLATED COVERAGE OF ANY SVR THREAT...THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DEEPENING BOUNDARY LAYER CIRCULATIONS WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR S OF A NRN-FL WARM FRONT HAVE BEEN SUPPORTING HORIZONTAL CONVECTIVE ROLLS/CLOUD STREETS ORIENTED PARALLEL TO LOW-LEVEL SWLY FLOW EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. AREA RADAR DATA SUGGEST THAT RELATIVELY DEEPER CONVECTIVE PLUMES HAVE OCCASIONALLY EVOLVED ALONG THE ASCENDING BRANCHES OF THESE ROLLS. MODIFIED 12Z TBW RAOB DATA TO ACCOUNT FOR SFC TEMPS IN THE LOWER 80S AND DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S AND LOWER 70S ARE SUPPORTING 1500-2500 J/KG OF MLCAPE. A FEW MORE VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS MAY EVOLVE THIS AFTERNOON OWING TO CONTINUED DIABATIC SFC HEATING...AND AS LOW-LEVEL ASCENT IS LOCALLY AUGMENTED INVOF A MODESTLY STRENGTHENING SEA BREEZE CIRCULATION ALONG THE NATURE COAST. ALSO...A SUPERCELL STORM OVER THE NE GULF WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED. WHILE ITS EVENTUAL IMPACTS TO THE FL BIG BEND ARE UNCERTAIN...IT MAY POSE A SVR THREAT TO PARTS OF LEVY COUNTY IN A FEW HOURS. STRONGER STORMS THAT DEVELOP WILL BE CONDITIONALLY CAPABLE OF PRODUCING SVR HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS...AS STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ACCOMPANYING AN EML COMBINE WITH 40-55 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR TO SUPPORT VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS. HOWEVER...THE GREATER SVR THREAT WILL BE CONFINED TO AREAS N OF THE MCD AREA -- NEAR AND N OF THE WARM FRONT -- WHERE STRONGER/DEEPER ASCENT AND RELATIVELY COOLER MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES WILL PROMOTE GREATER COVERAGE OF PERSISTENT CONVECTION. AS SUCH...ANY SVR THREAT WILL LIKELY BE ISOLATED ACROSS CNTRL/NRN PARTS OF THE FL PENINSULA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SVR STORMS CONTINUES ACROSS WW57.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE GREATEST NEAR-TERM SVR THREAT WILL EXIST WITHIN A CORRIDOR FROM AN ONGOING SUPERCELL MOVING INTO ST. JOHNS COUNTY. THIS SUPERCELL WILL LIKELY TRACK NEAR/JUST N OF A WARM FRONT TOWARD ST. AUGUSTINE THROUGH 1900-1930Z BEFORE MOVING OVER THE ADJACENT COASTAL ATLANTIC WATERS. SVR HAIL -- GOLF BALL TO TENNIS BALL SIZE -- WILL BE THE MAIN CONCERN WITH THIS STORM. HOWEVER...THIS STORM IS SHOWING SIGNS OF INTERACTING WITH A SFC WARM FRONT PER LATEST SFC MESOANALYSIS. IF THIS STORM INGESTS SFC-BASED EFFECTIVE INFLOW -- WHICH IS BECOMING OF INCREASING CONCERN -- THE THREAT FOR DMGG WINDS AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO/MARINE WATERSPOUT MAY INCREASE AS THE SUPERCELL APPROACHES THE COAST. ADDITIONAL CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP N OF THE AFOREMENTIONED SUPERCELL. WHILE EARLIER CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING HAS OCCURRED IN SOME AREAS...THE INFLUX OF STEEPER MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES UPSTREAM AMIDST STRONG DEEP SHEAR WILL MAINTAIN A THREAT FOR SVR HAIL. THIS WILL OCCUR AS ISENTROPIC ASCENT CONTINUES AMIDST A LOW-LEVEL WAA REGIME. ..COHEN.. 03/23/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A PORTION OF ERN TX AND MUCH OF NRN LA CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR AN INCREASING CHANCE FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT INTO THE AFTERNOON HOURS. A WATCH REMAINS POSSIBLE ACROSS THESE AREAS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT INCREASE IN TSTMS ACROSS WOOD...SMITH...AND HENDERSON COUNTIES IN E TX MAY BE THE FIRST SIGNS THAT STRONGER LARGE SCALE FORCING IS BEGINNING TO SPREAD EAST ACROSS THE REGION IN RESPONSE TO THE DIGGING VIGOROUS UPPER TROUGH ACROSS CO/NM. WHILE MUCH OF THE AREA FROM E TX INTO NRN LA WAS WELL NORTH OF SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY AND A WARM/QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT ALONG THE UPPER TX COAST...INDICATIONS ARE THAT STEEP LAPSE RATES ABOVE THE STABLE SURFACE LAYER AND MOISTENING THROUGH THE LOWER LEVELS WILL CONTINUE TO CONTRIBUTE TO STRONG INSTABILITY. AS LIFT STRENGTHENS WITH THE APPROACH OF THE UPPER SYSTEM THROUGH THIS EVENING...EXPECT BOTH STORM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY TO INCREASE. DYNAMIC FORCING FOR ASCENT SHOULD BECOME INCREASINGLY FOCUSED ALONG AND NORTH OF WEAK FRONTAL WAVE CYCLONE TRACK. THIS LOW MAY BE TAKING SHAPE OVER E TX ATTM AND IS FORECAST TO DEVELOP ENEWD ACROSS CNTRL LA THROUGH THIS EVENING. CONTINUED DESTABILIZATION AND POTENT BULK SHEAR ON THE ORDER 50-60KT SHOULD PROMOTE STOUT AND PERSISTENT TSTM UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL. WIND DMG AND SOME TORNADO POTENTIAL MAY INCREASE LATER AS LOW CENTER CONSOLIDATES OVER LA WHERE MODEST WARMING OF RECOVERING MARITIME TROPICAL AIRMASS COULD CONTRIBUTE TO SURFACE-BASED STORM INITIATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SVR STORMS -- WITH SVR HAIL BEING THE PRIMARY CONCERN -- PERSISTS ACROSS WW58.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITHIN A WAA REGIME...CONVECTION -- MOSTLY ELEVATED -- WILL CONTINUE TO BE MAINTAINED ACROSS THE N-CNTRL/NERN GULF COAST AND ADJACENT INLAND LOCATIONS THROUGH AT LEAST THE NEXT FEW HOURS. SPECIAL 18Z RAOBS AT JAN AND LIX SUGGEST THAT 7-7.5 C/KM 700-500-MB LAPSE RATES IN CONJUNCTION WITH AN EML WILL CONTINUE TO OVERSPREAD THE WW AREA AS STRONG WSWLY MID-LEVEL FLOW SUPPORTS 40-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR. SFC THETA-E DEFICITS ACCOMPANYING CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING N OF A QUASISTATIONARY FRONT LYING ALONG THE GULF COAST FROM MOBILE BAY TO THE FL BIG BEND IS LIMITING THE NWD-EXPANSION OF SFC-BASED EFFECTIVE INFLOW LAYERS INLAND. HOWEVER...SUPERCELLS INTERACTING WITH THE FRONT ALONG THE IMMEDIATE COASTLINE MAY PRODUCE DMGG WINDS...AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO...IN ADDITION TO SVR HAIL. ONE SUCH STORM COULD IMPACT AREAS AROUND PANAMA CITY FL DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. FARTHER N...CONVECTION WILL LIKELY BE ROOTED ABOVE A MORE STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER -- SAMPLED BY THE 18Z JAN RAOB -- WITH THE STRONGEST ELEVATED STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING SVR HAIL. ..COHEN.. 03/23/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WW57 MAY BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 21Z...AS THE SVR THREAT IS DIMINISHING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONTINUING WAA/ISENTROPIC ASCENT WILL MAINTAIN THE POTENTIAL FOR ELEVATED CONVECTION. HOWEVER...WIDESPREAD CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING N OF A W/E-ORIENTED WAVY QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT DRAPED ACROSS PARTS OF NRN FL HAS BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH A REDUCTION IN INSTABILITY. A FEW STRONG STORMS WITH SMALL HAIL...AND POSSIBLY AN ISOLATED INSTANCE OR TWO OF MARGINALLY SVR HAIL...MAY OCCUR DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS NERN FL INVOF THE FRONT. HOWEVER...THE THREAT FOR SVR HAIL IS DECREASING. AS SUCH...THE WW MAY BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE ON SCHEDULE AT 21Z. ..COHEN.. 03/23/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THROUGH EVENING WITH LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS AND A FEW TORNADOES POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS A LOW ACROSS NWRN LA...WITH A SYNOPTIC BOUNDARY EXTENDING NEWD INTO CNTRL MS. S OF THIS FRONT...A VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS EXISTS ALONG WITH MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ON THE ORDER OF 7.0-8.0 C/KM. AS THE UPPER SHORTWAVE TROUGH ADVANCES AND HEIGHT FALLS COMMENCE AFTER 00Z...SHEAR PROFILES SHOULD STRENGTHEN FURTHER...ESPECIALLY IN THE LOW LEVELS...CREATING A FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR SUPERCELLS. THE MOST LIKELY CORRIDOR FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND TORNADOES WILL BE ALONG THE FRONT ACROSS CNTRL MS THIS EVENING...AND THEN EXTENDING NEWD INTO AL LATER TONIGHT. FOR AREAS WELL N OF THE SURFACE FRONT...HAIL WILL BE LIKELY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED HAIL THREAT WILL CONTINUE ACROSS THE WW AREA THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. A NEW WW HAS REPLACED PORTIONS OF THE WATCH AREA FOR EXPECTED INCREASE IN SEVERE/TORNADO THREAT THIS EVENING. SEE MCD 307 FOR MORE DETAILS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ISOLATED HAIL THREAT WILL CONTINUE THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO TO THE NORTH OF STATIONARY BOUNDARY IN WAA REGIME. THE STRONGEST STORMS IN THE WATCH AREA WERE LOCATED OVER THE FLORIDA PANHANDLE AS OF 22Z. THESE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO WEAKEN AS THEY APPROACH THE NORTHERN FL PENINSULA WHERE INSTABILITY AND LAPSE RATES BECOME UNFAVORABLE FOR SUSTAINING STRONG/SVR STORMS. FARTHER WEST THE WARM FRONT WAS FURTHER INLAND...AND THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS SOUTHEAST MS INTO SWRN AL HAS LARGELY REMAINED IN TACT WITH POCKETS OF SFC HEATING ALLOWING MLCAPE VALUES TO APPROACH 500-1000 J/KG. AS LOW LEVEL SHEAR INCREASES WITH THE APPROACH OF MID LEVEL TROUGH...SEVERE AND/OR TORNADO THREAT WILL SUBSEQUENTLY INCREASE. THEREFORE...A NEW WW HAS REPLACED A SMALL PORTION OF WW 58 ACROSS SE MS. REFER TO MCD 307 FOR MORE DETAILS. OTHERWISE...SEVERE THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH ACROSS WESTERN PORTIONS OF THE WW AREA AS BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZATION CONTINUES INTO THE EVENING HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED CONVECTION MOVING INTO W-CNTRL AL WILL POSE A SEVERE HAIL THREAT. LATER TONIGHT...STRONGER ELEVATED QUASI-LINEAR SYSTEM IS EXPECTED TO MOVE INTO THE MCD AREA...POSING A MORE WIDESPREAD SEVERE HAIL THREAT. A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ACROSS E-CNTRL MS NEAR KMEI WILL REMAIN ELEVATED AS THEY TRACK TO THE NE TOWARD W-CNTRL/CNTRL AL. WEAK INSTABILITY SHOULD LIMIT INTENSITY/COVERAGE ACROSS THIS AREA...NORTH OF SVR WW 58....THOUGH STEEPENING MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES/COOL TEMPS ALOFT WILL ALLOW FOR AN ISOLATED HAIL THREAT. LATER THIS EVENING...UPSTREAM STORMS NEAR THE MS RIVER ARE EXPECTED TO GROW UPSCALE INTO A QUASI-LINEAR SYSTEM AS THEY TRACK EWD TOWARD AL IN ADVANCE OF MIDLEVEL TROUGH/SFC COLD FRONT. ELEVATED INSTABILITY AND VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILES ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE...SUPPORTING EMBEDDED ROTATING UPDRAFTS AND A THREAT FOR SEVERE HAIL. A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO FOR THIS ACTIVITY. FURTHER SOUTH ACROSS SRN AL...AN INCREASE IN CONVECTION HAS BEEN NOTED OVER NRN PORTIONS OF WW 58...BUT STILL REMAINS LARGELY UNORGANIZED. AS THESE STORMS TRACK NORTH THROUGH THE EVENING ORGANIZATION MAY BECOME SOMEWHAT BETTER WITH AN INCREASE IN HAIL POTENTIAL ACCOMPANYING CONVECTION. SINCE WW 58 IS SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE AT 01Z...PORTIONS OF THIS AREA MAY NEED TO BE INCLUDED IN A NEW WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE ENEWD ACROSS THE REGION AND MAY PERSIST INTO AL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR SHOWS TWO STRONG BOWING STORMS ACROSS NWRN MS AND NEAR THE ARKLAMISS. THESE STORMS HAVE BEEN SHOWING SIGNS UP INTENSIFICATION WITH AN INCREASE IN SIZE AS WELL AS LIGHTNING. SURFACE ANALYSIS ALSO SHOWS PRESSURE FALLS ARE MAXIMIZED IN THIS REGION...AND OTHER ECHOES WERE FORMING JUST AHEAD OF THESE TWO BOWS. GIVEN VERY STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR...A CONTINUED FORWARD PROPAGATION OF THESE SYSTEMS...ESPECIALLY THE SRN ONE...IS LIKELY. FURTHER INTENSIFICATION MAY OCCUR AS THE LOW LEVEL JET INCREASES LATER THIS EVENING IN RESPONSE TO THE UPPER TROUGH. ..JEWELL.. 03/23/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE HAIL THREAT WILL CONTINUE LATE THIS EVENING ACROSS WW 61.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL BUT PERSISTENT BOW ECHO THAT MOVED ACROSS CNTRL MS IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE EWD INTO CNTRL AL THIS EVENING. CONVECTION WILL REMAIN ROOTED ABOVE A STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER...LIMITING DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL DESPITE STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILES. GIVEN THESE WIND PROFILES...ROTATING UPDRAFTS ARE POSSIBLE AND STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL CONTINUE TO PROMOTE LARGE HAIL THREAT WITH EWD ADVANCING QLCS AS WELL AS WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS ACROSS SOUTHWESTERN PORTIONS OF THE WATCH AREA. ..LEITMAN.. 03/24/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW SEVERE STORMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS...WITH THE THREAT POSSIBLY EXTENDING INTO WRN GA. HOWEVER...A NEW WATCH MAY NOT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LONG LIVED LINE SEGMENT CONTINUES EWD ACROSS WRN AL...AND IS CURRENTLY POSITIONED IN A ZONE OF RELATIVELY STRONG WARM ADVECTION ATOP A STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER. ALTHOUGH THE LOW LEVELS ARE COOL...THE SUSTAINED NATURE OF THE BOW AS WELL AS STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR MAY HELP PRODUCE STRONG OR SEVERE WINDS. OTHER CELLS EXTENDED SEWD INTO SWRN GA WHERE WARM ADVECTION ALSO PERSISTED ATOP RAIN COOLED OUTFLOW FROM EARLIER. GIVEN WIDESPREAD RAIN AND ELEVATED NATURE OF MOST OF THE STORMS...MARGINAL HAIL APPEARS TO BE THE MAIN THREAT...AND AS SUCH A NEW WW MAY NOT BE NEEDED. IF STORMS OVER CNTRL MS MATURE AND DEVELOP EWD...A SECONDARY SEVERE CORRIDOR COULD DEVELOP WITH WIND AND HAIL. ..JEWELL.. 03/24/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SVR TSTMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THROUGH 12Z WITH A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WINDS. A WW IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ISOLATED STG/SVR TSTM OVER LAUDERDALE COUNTY MS IS LOCATED WITHIN A REGION OF MODEST WARM ADVECTION AND NORTH OF A SURFACE LOW BETWEEN MEI AND MOB. THE ASSOCIATED FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDS FROM THE SURFACE LOW ACROSS EXTREME SRN AL. THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA REMAINS SUPPORTIVE OF ISOLATED SVR TSTMS GIVEN MUCAPES OF 500 TO 1000 J/KG AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR AVERAGING 50 KTS. TSTM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED AS WARM ADVECTION REGIME SHIFTS NEWD WITH TIME. VEERING LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS ALSO EXPECTED AS MAIN SURFACE CONFLUENCE ZONE BECOMES ESTABLISHED SOUTH AND EAST OF THE AREA. LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT...WITH DAMAGING WINDS POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY ACROSS SRN PORTIONS OF AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A BAND OF THUNDERSTORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS ALONG A PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH...WITH AN INCREASING SEVERE STORM RISK AS THE SURFACE WARM SECTOR SPREADS SLOWLY INLAND. AREAS OF CENTRAL/ERN FL PANHANDLE...EXTREME SE AL...AND SW GA WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WATCH BY 09-10Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INLAND SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AND GULF BUOYS SHOW VEERING LOW-LEVEL FLOW FROM SW AL INTO THE N CENTRAL GULF OF MEXICO...W OF A SURFACE TROUGH/CONFLUENCE AXIS. IR SATELLITE IMAGERY CONFIRMS A BAND OF LOW-MIDLEVEL CONVECTIVE CLOUDS ALONG THIS BAND...WITH A TENDENCY FOR DEEPENING OF THE CONVECTION WITH TIME...AND STRONG DRYING FROM THE W ABOVE THE SURFACE PER PW IMAGERY. THIS BAND MATCHES WELL WITH THE ZONE OF PRE-FRONTAL CONVECTION SHOWN BY THE PAST SEVERAL RUNS OF THE HRRR...AND SHORT-TERM TRENDS SUGGEST THAT THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS UNDERWAY. AT THE SAME TIME...THE SURFACE WARM FRONT HAS BEEN MAKING SOME INLAND PROGRESS ACROSS THE FL PANHANDLE...WITH UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS NEAR THE COAST AND TEMPERATURES APPROACHING 70 F. THE MODIFIED 06Z TLH SOUNDING SUPPORTS MLCAPE NEAR 1000 J/KG. THUS...THE POTENTIAL FOR SURFACE-BASED STORMS IS INCREASING ACROSS THE FL PANHANDLE...IN AN ENVIRONMENT WITH SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS. THE THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS WILL INCREASE AS THE PRE-FRONTAL CONVECTIVE BAND INTENSIFIES IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS...AND THERE MAY ALSO BE A TORNADO RISK WHERE STORMS INTERACT WITH THE ZONE OF STRONGEST LOW-LEVEL SHEAR ALONG THE WARM FRONT. ..THOMPSON.. 03/24/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SVR TSTMS CONTINUES ACROSS THE WW AREA
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIDESPREAD TSTMS CONTINUE ACROSS WW 62 AS THE AREA IS LOCATED WITHIN A ZONE OF WARM ADVECTION NORTH OF A WARM FRONT. THE WARM FRONT EXTENDS FROM A SURFACE LOW OVER SWRN AL EASTWARD ACROSS NRN FL AND WILL LIFT SLOWLY NORTHWARD THROUGH 12Z...LIKELY REMAINING SOUTH OF WW THROUGH 12Z. ALTHOUGH SOME SVR THREAT EXISTS ACROSS THE ENTIRE WW...THE POTENTIAL IS GREATEST ACROSS THE SRN HALF OF WW AREA WHERE EFFECTIVE SHEAR...LAPSE RATES...AND ELEVATED INSTABILITY ARE MAXIMIZED. LARGE HAIL WILL REMAIN THE MAIN SVR THREAT...ALTHOUGH DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS SOUTHERN PORTIONS OF AREA THROUGH 12Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR WEATHER THREAT ACROSS WW 62 HAS DIMINISHED AS TSTM ACTIVITY CONTINUES EWD OUT OF THE WATCH AREA INTO SERN GA AND SWRN SC. SOME ADDITIONAL TSTM ACTIVITY IS POSSIBLE BUT IT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN SUB-SEVERE...PRECLUDING THE NEED FOR ANOTHER WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ELEVATED TSTM ACTIVITY HAS GRADUALLY SHIFTED EWD ACROSS WW 62. SOME ADDITIONAL TSTMS HAVE FORMED ALONG A WEAK FRONTAL BOUNDARY ASSOCIATED WITH A SURFACE LOW CONSOLIDATING ALONG THE CNTRL AL/GA BORDER. THESE STORMS SHOULD REMAIN ELEVATED AND N OF THE BEST INSTABILITY...LIMITING ANY SEVERE POTENTIAL. AS SUCH...WW 62 WILL EXPIRE AT 12Z WITH NO NEED FOR A NEW WW OVER THE AREA. ..MOSIER.. 03/24/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SVR TSTMS AND TORNADOES CONTINUES ACROSS REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WW. A NEW WW MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS PORTIONS OF SERN GA AND NRN FL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS HAVE BEEN FAIRLY WIDESPREAD ALONG A SURFACE CONFLUENCE ZONE AND HAVE INCREASED IN INTENSITY SINCE 1030Z. THIS CONFLUENCE ZONE EXTENDS SWD FROM A DEVELOPING SURFACE LOW PRESSURE CENTER OVER SWRN GA ACROSS THE CENTRAL FL PANHANDLE...WITH A WARM FRONT EXTENDING EAST FROM THE LOW TO THE GA/SC COAST. STRENGTHENING LOW-MID LEVEL FLOW HAS RESULTED IN STRONG 0-1 KM AND DEEP LAYER SHEARS ACROSS THE WW AREA WITH THE KTLH VWP SAMPLING 0-1 KM SRH IN EXCESS OF 450 M2/S2 AND 67 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR. SFC DEW POINTS SOUTH OF THE WARM FRONT WERE IN THE UPPER 60S RESULTING IN MLCAPE VALUES BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 J/KG NEAR AND SOUTH OF THE WARM FRONT. A SHORTWAVE LIFTING NEWD FROM THE BASE OF THE LARGE SCALE TROUGH WILL CONTINUE TO PROVIDE FORCING FOR ASCENT ACROSS THE WW AREA THROUGH MID MORNING. SVR TSTMS WITH A RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS...LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO OR TWO WILL CONTINUE TO BE POSSIBLE. THE SVR POTENTIAL WILL SHIFT EWD THROUGH 15Z AS LOW-LEVEL FLOW VEERS WITH THE PASSAGE OF THE CONFLUENCE ZONE...AND A NEW WW MAY BE REQUIRED OVER PORTIONS OF SERN GA AND NRN FL.
